svg.title: PyGMT logo
svg.desc: Vector serialization of the current PyGMT _create_logo geometry, using the original coordinates and colors and outlined AvantGarde-compatible URW Gothic Book glyphs. Design by Sfurti (Studio Raada), modified by the PyGMT team. CC BY 4.0. Source: https://github.com/GenericMappingTools/pygmt/blob/main/pygmt/src/pygmtlogo.py . Export is a derived SVG file, not an SVG distributed by PyGMT.
